description: This file defines an abstract class DurableGrain that manages state machines within the Orleans framework, including creation, registration, and state persistence.

classes.name: DurableGrain
classes.description: An abstract base class for grains that manage durable state machines within Orleans, providing methods for retrieving, creating, and persisting state machines.

methods.name: DurableGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the state machine manager and participates in the grain lifecycle if applicable.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStateMachine<TStateMachine>(string)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing state machine by name or creates a new one of type TStateMachine.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStateMachine<TState, TStateMachine>(string, Func<TState, TStateMachine>, TState)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing state machine or creates a new one with a specified state and creation function.
